text: The third one is multi-hop communication, which is also related to the issue of routing data packets in the network. And the fourth one is the fact that we would like to consume low power, so save energy as much as possible. Just one more comment about general comment about our device-to-device communication networks. As we already said, those networks are a set of devices that can communicate with each other, and these networks do not need any infrastructure. Now, due to this nature of this kind of communication networks, what we will need in these kind of networks is to use distributed algorithms. We know already what distributed algorithms means, right? Because DCF in Wi-Fi is an example of distributed algorithm for channel access. So distributed means that distributed decision algorithms means that every node should make a decision based on the information that he has got, and independently of the others. Right? That's what distributed.
